name: Foundry IMS
description: Foundry IMS is a multi-tenant inventory and product catalog platform. This connector lets you administer your Foundry catalog directly from Claude: create and update products and variants; manage pricing, SKUs, and identifiers (UPC/GTIN/MPN); organize brands and categories; add, reorder, and remove variant images; manage product bundles and custom fields; and build and inspect assemblies through their bill of materials — get and set BOMs, check how many units can be built from on-hand stock, run reverse "where-used" lookups, and flatten sub-assemblies into their component parts. Every action is scoped to your selected organization and gated by your Foundry permissions, so the connector can only read or change data you already have access to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Foundry IMS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Foundry IMS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.foundryims.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Foundry IMS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foundry IMS lists 32 MCP tools, including add_bundle_component, add_variant_image, bom_can_build, create_brand, create_category, create_product, delete_bom, delete_product, find_where_used, flatten_bom, get_bom, and get_bundle_components.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Foundry IMS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Foundry IMS in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Foundry IMS MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foundry IMS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Foundry IMS is developed by Foundry IMS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
